Ranker markers are shown in the meter and combat records for characters with at least 800K CP who place in the all-time or current-week tier TOP 20. Characters below 800K are excluded from ranker markers and ranker-granted nickname effects, but valid coupon effects apply regardless of CP. The current week resets every Wednesday at 05:00.

After a boss kill is confirmed, Prefer nDPS shows verified nDPS shared by you and party members beside each row. A qualifying bracket rank or Top 10% result appears in the same compact badge; without nDPS, only the existing rank or Top % is shown. Ranker marks and nickname effects remain unchanged. The default is ON.

DPS calculates bracket rank and Top % from kill DPS. Prefer nDPS uses trustworthy personal nDPS or verified nDPS shared by a NotMeter user in the same encounter, plus enough matching samples, from all-time records below 800K CP and current-week records at 800K CP or above. 2. Select the adapter connected to the mirror destination cable from the adapter list above.
